Opening Intelligence

Field identifier · offline · v40

Facility Dashboard → admin only
How to use — tap to expand
  1. Sign in and pick your Facility up top — or tap ＋ Add to set up a new one and choose its type.
  2. Enter the Location and Opening # for the door you're at.
  3. Choose 1 · What kind of part it is. The app then walks you through the photos to take — for a lock: the whole lock + cylinder, the inside trim, then the stamp.
  4. Tap Identify. Review the ranked shortlist and the confidence badge — a ⚠ needs review flag means read the stamp or shoot another angle.
  5. Tap 📄 View Cut Sheet to confirm finish & handing, and 📤 Send to Purchasing to fire off an order-ready packet (location, opening #, model, condition, photo, cut sheet).
  6. Tap Save & next opening →. The opening # steps up automatically; location and facility stay put, and everything syncs to the facility record.
  7. Facility managers see every opening, photo, and a condition-based health score in the desktop dashboard; identification accuracy is tracked in the Testing panel.

Set these once per door — the opening # auto-advances when you move to the next one.
Here because something is wrong, rather than to catalogue hardware. Everything is recorded against the opening.
The complaint as given to you. Not what you think it is.
One per line. Facts only — what you could see or measure.
Most likely first, one per line. These stay marked field verification required until you confirm one below.
Cost is recorded only with a reference. An unreferenced figure is not a realized cost.
This describes the visit, not the technician.
Completing this repair does not close the deficiency. It moves to repair complete, verification pending. Only a qualified verifier can close it.
Capture the door itself, then generate a QR to affix to it — a future scan pulls up every product installed on this opening.
Mark the opening complete once every part and the door are logged — this unlocks the QR.
A QR can only be created after the opening is finished. Affix it to the door — a future scan pulls up every product installed here, plus the door spec.
Take 2–3 shots of the opening — the whole door, the part close-up, and the stamp — then Identify. Or pick attributes below.
$
What you'd quote to repair or replace this opening. Rolls up into the facility's corrective-work total.
Fill this in once the repair or replacement is finished — it posts to the facility's service history and clears the item from open corrective work.
A door has several parts — log the closer, the lock, the hinges. When the whole opening is done, move to the next.
Bundles every part that needs ordering across all openings — identified model, condition, cost, and its cut sheet — into one request to purchasing.
